t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ten ilé, oh, in Jajal-Dios, tech dzaen yolal in kajoltquech yolal kulquech. Ten ilâe ti junzutäj, minaan in bak, teché yan á muk, otalên; teche ayiklech yetel yacunaal. Minaan u laak Jajal-Dios, chen tech, tech ca antaj can anac baal kaz, cu cuxtal chen leti.
